name: Dream Chasers
source:
A tyrannical organization known as the Shadow Cross now rules the world with an iron fist. A rebellion is impending, and fate once again draws kindred souls together. 

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20170115230326/http://renai.us/game/dc.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
名为“暗影十字”的暴政组织如今以铁腕统治世界。反抗即将爆发，命运再次把心灵相通的人们聚到一起。

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20170115230326/http://renai.us/game/dc.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
